name: Bay Fourteen
setup: Level P2 of the hotel garage is dark, full of cars and full of Husks between them. The bureau car is one of five identical grey sedans in the reserved row. Leon has the key but not a description.
solution: Walk the reserved row (bays 12 to 16). Within 6 m of the right car the fob chirps and the indicators flash once. Press interact at the driver door.
failure: Trying the wrong cars sets off their alarms. An alarm is a noise: every Husk on the level wanders toward it, which makes the row harder to cross unseen. Nothing locks.
hint_1: Bays twelve to sixteen. The reserved row.
hint_2: The fob chirps when you are close. Listen for it.
hint_3: Far wall, fourth car from the ramp. Bay fourteen.
hint_trigger: 45 s on P2, then 90 s or one alarm, then 150 s or two alarms.
